description: Start a real, live agent_sketchpad drawing: one Gemini call plans a complete picture as an ordered list of SVG strokes, the first stroke renders immediately, and the rest reveal as you call sketch_agent_poll again — a real multi-turn task, not a single one-shot render. MCP Apps hosts only (same as render_surface). Stateless server: the task is held in KV for 1 hour, not in this connection — keep the returned taskId and the next cursor to keep polling.

subject.description: What to draw, e.g. "a lighthouse at sunset". Max 150 characters.

name: sketch_agent_start

blocks.description: The sketchpad with the first stroke drawn. Task id, cursor, total and done are in the result _meta.
